notes: 🏰 Tower Defense now plays for real points: troops cost your points and every wave you clear pays points back (plus your kills). Prices and pay follow the team's average points (an Archer is about 0.5% of it), so everyone plays for the same stakes — up to 3,000 + 5% of your points a day. The castle now shows your team's profile pictures. Also: link your devices (⚙️ › Link devices), and the chat's on/off switches are inside ⚙️.
